16.
(1)  A  Certification  Service  Provider  shall  not  be
subject to any civil or criminal liability for any transaction
under  this  Act  in  respect  of  third  party  information  in  the
form  of  data  messages,  electronic  documents,  electronic
records or other communications to which he merely provides
access,  if such liability is founded,on —

(a)
the  making,  publication,  dissemination,  or
distribution  of  such  information  or  any  statement
made in such information ; or

(b)
the  infringement  of  any  rights  subsisting  in  or  in
relation to such information.
